defect_answered: v06 QA defect 5: at 30 fps a re-press 1 frame after a late-stance release lifted BOTH boots on one frame (city-bright, release frame 6: cell silhouette change 484 px vs 473 for the run).  Cause: the restart re-plans the airborne / other boot into a fresh swing whose lift rises to its peak (replan_lift_min 2) at mid-swing, while the planted boot - re-derived as the stance boot - passes its lift-off point (stance q 21) within one 9.3 px 30 fps step.  So on the frame the stance boot leaves the floor the re-planned boot is still rising (here a boot that was coming down to its v8 spot at lift 1 went back up to 2).  The same mechanism shows one frame after a 30 fps start from idle and after re-presses from both-planted states (the stance boot lifts before the re-planned swing peaks).  In the steady run this never happens: when one boot rises the other is planted or coming down.

restart_amendment.rule: v07 rise lock (re-press / start / re-entry only).  A boot on a RE-PLANNED swing never rises while the other boot is off the floor: on every moving frame on which the other boot is not in contact, the re-planned boot's lift is at most the lift it was drawn with on the previous frame (non-increasing until its touchdown).  So on the frame the stance boot pushes off, the re-planned boot reaches for the floor instead of rising, as the leading boot does in the steady run.  Only the drawn lift (and the lift a later release starts its landing from) changes: the re-planned boot's offset, view, knee lean, scheduled touchdown distance and therefore the gait phase, stride sync, alternation, the planted boot's world position and every timing are v06's.  A boot that leaves contact on this frame is never clamped (its lift-off stays as planned).
restart_amendment.applies_to: boots whose swing was re-planned by the restart rule (manifest restart.rule): after a re-press, the start from the v8 idle, and the re-entry after a reversal.  Ordinary gait swings (stance lift-off) and the stop (land / shuffle moves) are untouched.
restart_amendment.lift_floor: a re-planned boot in the air keeps lift >= 1 (its first re-planned frame is drawn at max(1, lift)), so the clamp never puts an airborne boot on the floor
